ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This online course for students in the Springfield cohort begins August 26 and ends December 9. Class sessions will be held on Thursday evenings from 6:00 to 8:50 PM. The course content and instruction will be delivered using both the Compass course management system and Elluminate conferencing technology. There will also be approximately five face-to-face class sessions held on the University of Illinois at Springfield campus. The dates for the face-to-face sessions are August 26, October 7, November 18, December 2 and December 9. The The face-to-face classes will be held in the University Hall (UHB) building in room 2024. The email address for the instructor is: dcrowell@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $423.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
